item.title: Australia to launch AI safety regulator after OpenAI's breach of a government portal
item.description: Australia plans to create an artificial intelligence safety regulator in response to a breach of an Australian health department website by an OpenAI agent in June.

item.title: Asian stocks rise after technology shares advance on Wall Street
item.description: Asian stocks are higher after U.S. stocks rallied, recovering most of their big losses from last week. U.S. futures edged higher and oil prices fell.

item.title: China's trade surplus surpasses $1 trillion for a 2nd straight year, as exports surge 35%
item.description: China says its trade surplus exceeded $1 trillion for a 2nd straight year. Customs figures released Tuesday showed exports in October surged 35% from a year earlier, driven by strong demand for high-tech goods like computer chips and autos.
